answers.core:
This is an extension to Godot's shader capabilities.

It should also be stated a GLSL extension might be required for this. [EXT_fragment_shader_barycentric](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/GLSL/master/extensions/ext/GLSL_EXT_fragment_shader_barycentric.txt) is the most vendor neutral but unsure how supported it currently is in GPUs.
answers.workaround: As noted before, storing custom data or calculating it in the *vertex* function is possible, but can break for most models and requires tedious setup.
